notes: §1985:X.5.2.3 SR3: each USING operand is a data item of the File, Working-Storage, Communication or Linkage Section and "must be a level 01 data item, a level 77 data item, or an elementary data item". The section half is CallBinder#ScreenCallOperand via ParameterConformance#ScreenSection (StorageSectionRule.Cobol85); the level half is VersionConformancePass#GateStatement's call-using-group-any-level-2002 row, which tests only IsGroup with a level other than 01/77 on the item behind the place. Correct at 85 for 01/77/elementary, subscripted elementary, ODO 01, File and Communication 01 records (run), subordinate groups by reference and by content, group table elements, report items, condition-names, index-names, cd-names, LINAGE-COUNTER, PAGE-COUNTER. Wrong for two shapes: (1) a 66 RENAMES ... THRU item, a group item per §1985:VI.5.11.4 GR1 ("When data-name-3 is specified, data-name-1 is a group item"), is accepted (under-rejects); (2) a reference-modified subordinate group WG(1:2), which §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5 makes "an elementary data item", is refused COBOL0900 (rejects legal source), because the gate reads the reference-modified place's base item. Not filed in kb/Work: PB4305 introduced the gate and covers neither shape; PB4901 and PB4938 cover the section half only. kb/Work PB5383 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-reread2/rr-06.json).

next.reason: 1985: "Communication Section, or Linkage Section, and must be a level 01 data item, a level 77 data item, or an elementary data item"; 2023: "Identifier-2 shall reference an address-identifier or a data item defined in the file, working-storage, local-storage, or linkage section.". 2023 drops the level 01/77/elementary limit, so subordinate group items are allowed. Communication Section is gone; local-storage and address-identifiers are added.
